convertibility_reason: Multi-timeframe logic, adaptive parameter optimization loop, partial close logic declared, ATR-based dynamic trailing stop with multiple tiers, performance-based risk adjustment, and the backtest optimization framework makes automated conversion unreliable without manual review

derived_values.name: Adjusted risk percent
derived_values.formula: currentRiskPercent (starts at MaxRiskPercent, adjusted by ±0.05 based on win rate)

other_exits: Break-even logic declared via BreakEvenMultiplier input but not explicitly implemented in OnTick; PartialTakeProfitPercent (50%) declared but partial close logic not implemented in visible code
ApplyTrailingStop uses hardcoded tiers: profit > 2*ATR → trail at 1.5*ATR; profit > 1*ATR → trail at 1.0*ATR; else → trail at 0.5*ATR

params.volume_normalization: floor to volume_step, clamp to min/max volume

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Risk percent adapts: winRate < 0.4 → risk -0.05 (min 0.05); winRate > 0.6 → risk +0.05 (max MaxRiskPercent)

custom_logic_notes: 1) Adaptive parameter optimization: brute-force grid search over RSI period (8-14), ATR multiplier (1.0-2.0 step 0.5), trailing stop multiplier (1.0-2.0 step 0.5), trailing TP multiplier (1.0-2.0 step 0.5) - but BacktestWithParameters() is a placeholder returning 0.0, so optimization is non-functional. 2) Performance-based risk adjustment modifies currentRiskPercent based on win/loss counts, but win/loss counters are never updated in visible code. 3) Multi-symbol support via SymbolTradeState array (up to 100 symbols) but only _Symbol is added in OnInit. 4) News avoidance filter is placeholder (always returns false). 5) tradeActive flag per symbol prevents stacking but is never reset to false when position closes. 6) ApplyTrailingStop reads PositionGetInteger/PositionGetDouble without first selecting a position via PositionSelect or PositionSelectByTicket, which is a bug - it will operate on whatever position was last selected. 7) RSI handle created with hardcoded period 14 in AddSymbolState, ignoring the optimized currentBestSet.periodRSI.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The adaptive optimization framework (OptimizeParameters) is non-functional as BacktestWithParameters is a stub - needs full implementation or removal. 2) Multi-timeframe MA (H1 trend) requires bar data alignment with M5 - use resampling or dual timeframe data feed. 3) Trailing stop has 3 ATR-based tiers - must replicate exactly. 4) The per-symbol state tracking (tradeActive, winCount, lossCount) has bugs: tradeActive never resets on close, win/loss never updated - must fix in Python version. 5) Position selection bug in ApplyTrailingStop must be corrected - need to iterate positions by symbol and ticket. 6) Lot sizing uses risk_percent / (ATR*multiplier*_Point) - careful with _Point equivalent in Python (pip/tick size). 7) CTrade.PositionModify call in trailing stop passes 0 for take_profit (removes TP) - this is intentional to let trailing manage exits. 8) Spread filter uses raw point difference / _Point - convert to pip equivalent in Python.
